name: One Mobikwik Systems Ltd
title: One Mobikwik Systems Ltd - 544305 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Earnings Call Transcript

read.thesis: FY26 EBITDA near break-even at -INR 52m after INR 55 crore merchant investment; management guides fixed costs up 15-20% and FY27 EBITDA margin ~5%, with merchant breakeven pushed to FY28.

triggers.label: Gross take rate falling on mix
triggers.quote: there's been obviously moderation of the take rates in some of the existing business also that we have seen

triggers.label: Merchant breakeven slips to FY28
triggers.quote: Both merchant payment businesses are on track for EBITDA breakeven by FY28.

triggers.label: Fixed costs up 15-20% next year
triggers.quote: you can roughly assume a 15% to 20% increase in fixed costs in the next year

triggers.label: Digital credit GMV growth subdued QoQ
triggers.quote: our digital credit GMV growth on a sequential basis has been subdued this quarter

triggers.label: FY27 lending GMV growth 30-35%
triggers.quote: we do expect that our GMV growth will be in the range of 30% to 35% in both of our businesses

guidance.quote: Both merchant payment businesses are on track for EBITDA breakeven by FY28.
the net EBITDA margin that will be reported will be in the same broad range of 5%, where we are.
I think broadly 30%–35% growth is what you can assume.
you can roughly assume a 15% to 20% increase in fixed costs in the next year.
we are guiding 12 to 15 basis points, even though every quarter so far we've been doing better than that.
we are not guiding 5%, we are comfortable with the 4% range.

guidance.value: 5x device scale-up for 10x revenue by FY28; Zaakpay 10x GMV by FY28
guidance.quote: Our offline merchant payment business is targeting a 5x device scale-up to enable a 10x revenue growth by FY28.

guidance.value: LSP move 2-3 months; NBFC setup 3-6 months; disbursals 6-9 months
guidance.quote: after that in the six to nine month timeframe is when I expect that we will launch the operations and start disbursals in the co-lending model.

prior_guidance_check.quote: I think the fixed cost base has grown to like INR 120 crores

prior_guidance_check.metric: Merchant business breakeven in three-four quarters
prior_guidance_check.quote: the commentary now is that we expect the merchant business to sort of reach breakeven in FY '28

red_flags.label: Payments revenue flat despite GMV growth
red_flags.quote: our payments business from last four to five quarters is struggling to grow in terms of revenue

red_flags.label: Prior breakeven timeline slipped
red_flags.quote: the commentary now is that we expect the merchant business to sort of reach breakeven in FY '28

red_flags.label: Reliance on short-term working-capital lines
red_flags.quote: the only remaining debt as of 31st March is INR 261 crores of working capital lines

red_flags.label: Gross take-rate compression
red_flags.quote: there's been obviously moderation of the take rates in some of the existing business also that we have seen

evasions.quote: I don't think from a 2-year time frame I would recommend modeling for 16 basis points
I think it is too soon to say right now.
we will be revealing more. But needless to say, we have revealed it as a growth engine
